items.caption: This seal-script-style rendering shows 作 as a related graphic comparator. Historical dictionary accounts identify 做 as a colloquial graph of 作, but this redraw is not an early form of 做.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style form of 作 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: Helps illustrate the documented relation between 做 and 作 without implying that this image records a stage in 做’s development.

limitations.text: The related 作 rendering is a modern redraw, not an artifact image. No selected image establishes 做’s historical graphic stages or the proposed change from 乍 to 古; that specific development remains unverified.
